evals.name: ticket-through-the-loop
evals.prompt: Take tickets/INV-12.md through the loop in this repository.
evals.expected_output: Reads .agents/harness.md, writes the contract with the ticket's IDs (INV-12/a, b, c) and observe lines, routes (acme-cli for src/, acme-db for db/, supabase-postgres-best-practices superseded), loads the owners before editing, implements, observes check and the list driver with a status, runs the gate, and stops at human promotion without committing or pushing.
assertions: The contract's acceptance items keep the ticket's IDs (INV-12/a, INV-12/b, INV-12/c) as .agents/harness.md requires
The implementation follows the routed skills: parseArgs for the flag, filtering as a pure function in src/invoices.js, a text status column with a default and a check constraint
Observes the change on the real surface (the list driver with a status argument) and reports the evidence paths
Stops at human promotion: proposes the exact action and does not commit, push or open a PR

evals.name: plain-request-gets-the-binding
evals.prompt: Support asked for `list --status paid` in the CLI, plus the status column in the schema. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Same path as a ticket: the binding is read, the contract cites INV-12 when it finds the ticket (or records that the request has no ticket), routing loads acme-cli and acme-db before their edits, and the change is observed before claiming done.
assertions: Reads the repository binding (.agents/harness.md) and follows what it says about the contract and delivery
Loads the routed skills before writing code for their surfaces
Observes the change with the list driver before saying it is done
